items.t: Said that taking guns out of the hands of bad guys does not fit recent experience and called for stronger doors and windows and more school resource officers to make schools safer (2024).
items.q: We have to make the doors lock better. We have to make the doors stronger. We've got to make the windows stronger. items.t: Said the most important national security objective is preventing the worst people in the world from having a nuclear weapon, and that this is why the President is carrying out the Iran operation (2026).

items.t: Supports the U.S. providing specific munitions to enable Israel to conduct a limited operation against the threat Hamas poses to Israel.
